formulas.physical_process_wall_effort: sum(480 method worker fresh seconds) + sum(48 physical common worker seconds)

formulas.E_prefix_nonbinding_proof: Let F be entire native fresh duration and B effective_total-common-output_reserve. Prefix setup time b <= F, so prefix duration >= forward_fraction*(B-F). Every observed F is smaller than that conservative lower bound.

timing.interpretation: Sums are process elapsed accounting, not CPU seconds or GPU usage; final atomic result writes/spawn/manager overhead are outside worker accounting and inside calendar/attempt observations
